comment: Super easy, everthything is borderline open book, final presentation is tough but you have a lot of time to work on it and can get help easily.
Not the easiest class but I learned a lot. Take good notes and participate. My course grade was much higher than the grade I thought I was getting. Would take her again.

Dr. Lascu is obviously very experienced and knowledgeable, but her lectures can get pretty boring. There's a semester-long group project with quite vague guidelines. I also felt like her answers to questions regarding expectations were vague too. Exams can get pretty tough; she had to give a 14-point curve for our second midterm.
Not sure about the grade, offered do overs at the beginning. Enjoyed the discussions and learned a lot. Liked the practical applications. Prof is smart and knowledgeable.

Decent number of group projects with the same group each time that has been assigned by the teacher. Some group assignments feel like busywork.  Professor will curve everything. Lecturing are not engaging. Basically no homework. Still requiring masks if you care about that. Overall, easy class, but did not feel as though I learned much.
Cool class, learned a lot.Allows do overs and curves grades at the end.
Great class. Would definitely recommend. Cases were great and timely.

Learned a lot in this class about international marketing, even about marketing and especially about current practices. Dr. Lascu is very knowledgeable. Quizzes are hard and you have to study for them. Participation is one quarter of the grade so. Im a little worried. Great course otherwise.
OK class, many tests and presentations

Dr. Lascu really does care about her student and she was always accessible outside of class. The course was laid out at the beginning of the year clearly but throughout the year she would change due dates and classes without making it known. Lectures were confusing to follow as she would just talk about things as she thought them up it felt like.

Dr. Lascu is the most intelligent woman I have ever met. She is flexible with deadlines and a fair grader that gives good feedback. Most of the semester is spent in a group, working on a large research paper that gets published at the end of the semester. The other aspects of your grade include 3 exams, 4 Facebook discussions, and participation.

Dr. Lascu is an amazing professor, she's one of the most intelligent people I have ever met. However, she lacks clarity when it comes to some of her assignments, but if you ask her for help, she hasn't taken longer than an hour to respond to my emails. And she's helpful when I need it. I hope she advises me in the future!
One of the most intelligent women I have ever met. Very helpful during class. Great person to have a conversation with. Very caring about her class and subject material.
So frustrating to work with. Really tries to brainwash you into thinking only her thoughts rather than allowing you to create your own. DO NOT TAKE!!
Professor Lascu is an awesome professor. Readings are a bit long but can be skimmed. Group-project is extensive but rewarding in the end.

I really enjoyed Lascu's FYS. She is extremely caring about her students but also has fairly high expectations. Her instructions are unclear but project topics are very interesting. Overall I think this class prepared me very well for B School.

Dr. Lascu is amazing! Her FYS is awesome and got almost everyone in the class interested in business. Sometimes her instructions were a bit unclear, but if you asked her to clarify / for extra help she is always there for you! She really focuses on creating strong relationships with students

She genuinely cares about each of her students' wellbeing. She is very supportive and is flexible with deadlines, homeworks, etc. Only 3 tests per semester & a take-home final; is extremely qualified in marketing; readings tend to be numerous and lengthy; skimming is recommended. Sometimes she's vague/unclear. semester is group project-based.

I love her! She is so knowledgable and an expert in her field, but is kind of difficult to understand with grading criteria or preparing for a test. Studying for one of her tests is pretty impossible, but she is a very fair grader. She's so cool though. Would take again!

Unbelievably knowledgable/passionate about marketing. Fairly easy & I would take her again but should point out a couple of things. She is UNBELIEVABLY VAGUE ON EVERYTHING - can't get this point across enough. Not much homework except for 3 weeks where she swamps you. You have to PARTICIPATE. If you don't, she's known to give 0s (10% of grade).

Dr. Lascu is AMAZING. She speaks like four languages and has taught/studied/been to everywhere you can imagine. She practically begs you to come see her so she can help. Anything you ask, she'll find a way to make it happen. Grades are mostly dependent on a group project so choose wisely. Even as a non-business major I loved this class & Dr. Lascu!

I love Dr. Lascu. She is one of the most kind people I've ever met, so accessible. This FYS was a bit unorganized. At times, due dates were unclear, but in the end she worked it out. Lots of group work, make sure you get a good group from the start. The tests were hard but reasonable, just study the readings and slides. If going to BSchool take it

Dr. Lascu is awesome...she has been everywhere and done everything. She incorporates all of her experience into her lectures and it was one of the courses which I made sure to attend because it was fun and interesting. Doesn't teach fundamentals of mkt that often but when she does-take her!
Love her! I took the class without any interest in marketing and left wanting to major in business...she is so helpful and appreciates hard work. I would take a class with her again in a heartbeat.

Dana is a fun, upbeat teacher who will bend over backwards to make sure the students understand the concepts and goals of the course. For a first-year seminar, her assigned projects seemed like a lot of work but at the end of the day, she rewards you with a well-deserved grade. Awesome class and I would highly suggest it to any student.
Nicest woman, she's been all over the world and done crazy things.  Helpful if you go to her office hours.
One of my favorite classes/professors during my undergraduate years.
Nice woman, but very boring
Values hard work and really cares for her students. Gives you much freedom concerning papers and exams- that makes you feel independant and that you have really done the work yourself.
Great teacher, never boring. Lots of examples and experience.
Great class where you can learn that there is the world outside the US.
No Comments

I took 2 classes with her and she is one of my two favorite professors at Richmond.  She loves her field and really takes an interest in her students.  Her experience is extensive and she uses it to teach.  I HIGHLY recommend her!
Avoid International Marketing like the plague. Makes you do unnecessary work. Thinks her class is a priority over others. Extremely vague in her textbook/writing/directions. WAY too much work.
